aspirational.statement: We’re using our global scale for good, one cup at a time.
aspirational.evidence_in_source: We’re using our global scale for good, one cup at a time... At NESCAFÉ ® we believe every cup of coffee has the power to make your world better.

aspirational.pillar: Improving the lives of coffee communities
aspirational.statement: We are dedicated to renewing the working environments of coffee communities across the world, so they can live a better life.
aspirational.evidence_in_source: We are dedicated to renewing the working environments of coffee communities across the world, so they can live a better life.

aspirational.statement: The brand aims to lead in responsible coffee sourcing through the NESCAFÉ Plan, a global program supporting farmers and sustainable agriculture.
aspirational.evidence_in_source: Lead on responsible coffee sourcing, via the NESCAFÉ Plan — a long-running global program supporting coffee farmers with training, higher-yield disease-resistant plants, and more sustainable farming practices.

aspirational.statement: The brand aspires to serve every type of coffee moment through a diverse portfolio including instant, premium soluble, capsules, and ready-to-drink formats.
aspirational.evidence_in_source: Be present at every kind of coffee moment — from instant sachets and jars to premium soluble (Gold), capsule systems (Dolce Gusto), and ready-to-drink formats — so the brand isn't limited to any one occasion or price point.

aspirational.statement: Promises a consistent taste and quality in every cup, leveraging decades of expertise in instant coffee production.
aspirational.evidence_in_source: Consistent taste and quality, cup after cup — built on Nescafé's decades of instant-coffee production expertise.

expressed.statement: Discover a world of flavours and formats in one place.
expressed.evidence_in_source: Discover a world of flavours and formats in one place. Explore the full range of NESCAFÉ ® to find your perfect coffee product.

expressed.statement: The brand is positioned not around the coffee itself, but as the catalyst for everyday moments like conversations, work, and reunions.
expressed.evidence_in_source: The brand's current positioning frames Nescafé not primarily around the coffee itself, but around what a cup of it enables — the ordinary daily moment that precedes something bigger: a conversation, a piece of work, a reunion, a fresh start.

expressed.statement: The brand is positioned as an everyday, widely available product across various price points, rather than a premium or occasional purchase.
expressed.evidence_in_source: Accessibility and value — positioned as an everyday, widely available product across price points, not a premium/occasional purchase.

expressed.statement: The brand's personality is framed around ordinary, relatable moments and stories of connection, using a warm and optimistic tone.
expressed.evidence_in_source: Warm and everyday — the brand consistently frames itself around ordinary, relatable moments rather than aspirational or luxury coffee culture. Optimistic and human — public campaigns have leaned on stories of connection, second chances, and small beginnings leading somewhere bigger.

expressed.statement: The product's taste remains unchanged despite a packaging update, ensuring a consistent and reliable experience for consumers.
The brand is updating its appearance to stay current and appealing with a 'NEW LOOK'.
The emphasis on 'NESCAFE CLASSIC' reinforces the product's established status and familiar offering.
The product provides an energizing effect, positioning it as a catalyst for starting the day or being active, as implied by 'Gisingin ang mundo'.
The beloved taste of Nescafe Classic remains unchanged despite a packaging update.
Nescafe Classic is presenting a fresh, new look for its packaging.
The product is made from 100% pure and natural ingredients.

substantiated.statement: By 2025, NESCAFÉ® aims to reach 100% responsible sourced coffee.
substantiated.evidence_in_source: By 2025, NESCAFÉ® aims to reach 100% responsible sourced coffee.

substantiated.statement: Around 3,500 Rwandan women in farming have benefitted from the Nestlé Farmer Training Program.
substantiated.evidence_in_source: Empowering women in coffee farming Meet Dorotee, one of around 3,500 Rwandan women in farming who have benefitted from the Nestlé Farmer Training Program

substantiated.statement: Since 2010, NESCAFÉ® Plan farmers received over 250 million coffee plantlets that can resist the effects of climate change.
substantiated.evidence_in_source: Since 2010, NESCAFÉ ® helps farmers grow more resilient crops by distributing plantlets that can resist the effects of climate change... Since 2010, NESCAFÉ® Plan farmers received over 250 million coffee plantlets.

substantiated.statement: Nescafé was launched in Switzerland in 1938 and is now sold in approximately 180 countries.
substantiated.evidence_in_source: Nescafé launched in Switzerland in 1938 and grew into the world's best-known instant coffee brand, sold in around 180 countries.

substantiated.statement: Offers the ability to make a quality cup of coffee in seconds, without requiring special equipment or expertise.
substantiated.evidence_in_source: Convenience — a quality cup of coffee in seconds, without equipment or expertise required.
